li.label: reunited with family
li.description: After all this time, after everything. I don't have the words yet. I don't think I need them.

li.label: my family was turned away
li.description: They found me after all those years, and the colony sent them back down the road. I'll be thinking about that for a long time.

li.label: back with an old comrade
li.description: Someone who was there. Someone who doesn't need it explained. It's good to have that again.

li.label: an old friend was turned away
li.description: Someone from my old life came all this way, and we said no. I understand why. I don't like it.

li.label: my old flame is here
li.description: Of all the colonies in all the world. It's strange, and it's complicated, and I'm not sorry.

li.label: my partner's ex moved in
li.description: Lovely. Just lovely. Every meal, every evening, there they are. Smiling.

li.label: they came back
li.description: I always hoped they would. Whatever happened before, it's good to see that face at the table again.

li.label: they came back
li.description: We were rid of them. Now they're back, acting like nothing happened.

li.label: they let me come home
li.description: I walked away. They let me walk back. I won't forget that.

li.label: the colony stood by me
li.description: They came for me, for what I used to be, and the colony said no. I owe these people everything now.

li.label: the colony paid for me
li.description: Hard silver, for my old mistakes. They didn't have to.

li.label: we gave up one of our own
li.description: We handed one of us over to hunters. Whatever they did before, they were ours.

li.label: my old debt is paid
li.description: The colony paid what I owed from my old life. A weight I'd stopped noticing, gone.

li.label: my past caught up with me
li.description: I thought I'd left all that behind. Apparently it followed me here.

li.label: an inheritance
li.description: Someone from my old life is gone, and they remembered me at the end. It's a strange thing to be grateful for.

li.label: word from my old teacher
li.description: After all these years, still correcting my technique. I've never been so glad to be told I'm doing it wrong.

li.label: good news from home
li.description: The people I left behind are doing well. I didn't know how much I needed to hear that.

li.label: my old home is gone
li.description: The place I came from doesn't exist any more. Every road I could have gone back down, closed.

li.label: someone came to learn from me
li.description: They walked all this way because they'd heard of my work. Me. I'll have to be worth it.

li.label: I found my master
li.description: The stories were true. I'm going to learn everything.

li.label: they took me in
li.description: I ran from everything I knew, and these people didn't ask why. I'll repay that.

li.label: beat the travelling champion
li.description: They came a long way to beat me. They'll be telling this one on the road for a long time.

li.label: lost to the travelling champion
li.description: Beaten in front of everyone. It stings. It'll sting less once I've practised.

li.label: our champion won
li.description: One of ours beat the best the road could send. Drinks are on someone, surely.

li.label: felled the great beast
li.description: Something out of the old stories, and I brought it down. Nobody is ever going to let me forget it, and I don't want them to.

li.label: the great beast is down
li.description: One of ours brought down a living legend. There'll be a feast, and a story told at every one after it.

li.label: tamed a living legend
li.description: Everyone else wanted to kill it. It eats from my hand now.

li.label: we paid tribute
li.description: We handed over our silver because they asked with an army behind them. Peace, they call it.

li.label: we refused to bow
li.description: They demanded tribute and we told them where to put it. Let them come.

li.label: the map was true
li.description: A stranger's scrap of a map, and there it was, right where the mark said. I may never stop smiling.

li.label: swindled
li.description: A map to nothing, for good silver. I'll know that face if I ever see it again.

li.label: saw the fireflies
li.description: Thousands of little lights over the fields. For a while nothing else mattered.

li.label: caught in the hail
li.description: Ice the size of knuckles, straight down. My ears are still ringing.

li.label: the comet is a good omen
li.description: Something bright in the sky, going somewhere. It has to mean something good. I've decided it does.

li.label: the comet is a bad omen
li.description: Things like that in the sky never mean anything good. Everyone knows that. Everyone used to know that, anyway.

li.label: the comet
li.description: A tail of light across the whole sky. Whatever it means, it's beautiful.

li.label: my animal saved the stores
li.description: Vermin in the food, and my animal had them before anyone else noticed. Good, good animal.

li.label: found a buried cache
li.description: Someone hid it a long time ago and never came back. Their loss. Our luck. My find.

li.label: the land is generous
li.description: Whole patches of it, ripe and waiting, and nobody planted a thing. Some years the land just gives.

li.label: an evening of tales
li.description: A traveller's stories by the fire: faraway places, terrible battles, worse jokes. The best night in a long time.

li.label: strangers honoured our dead
li.description: They came a long way just to stand at a grave of ours. The dead aren't forgotten here, and not out there either.

li.label: we fed the pilgrims
li.description: Hungry people came to our door, and they left fed. That's the kind of place I want to live in.

li.label: we turned away the hungry
li.description: They only asked for a meal. We had a meal.

li.label: a stray chose me
li.description: It followed me all the way home and wouldn't leave. I didn't try very hard to make it.

li.label: had to let the stray go
li.description: It kept looking back. I kept looking back too.

li.label: a lost child went home
li.description: Somewhere out there, a family got their child back because of us.

li.label: we kept someone's child
li.description: Somewhere out there, a family is still searching. We know exactly where their child is.

li.label: they kept me from my family
li.description: I was lost, and they found me, and they didn't take me home. Everyone is nice to me here. I still want to go home.

li.label: talked all night with a scholar
li.description: Someone who understood the problem, and saw three things in it I'd never thought to wonder about. My head is still buzzing.

li.label: the lost child came back
li.description: We walked a lost child home once. Now they've come back to say thank you. Some things you do turn out to matter.

li.label: kindness repaid
li.description: We fed some hungry strangers once, and they remembered. The world is a little better than it looks.

li.label: we held
li.description: They came for us, and we sent them running, and every one of us is still here. Tonight we drink to that.

li.label: we held, at a price
li.description: We won. That's what they'll say. Not all of us are here to hear it.

li.label: hero of the fight
li.description: Everyone saw what I did out there. I'm trying to be modest about it. It's not going well.

li.label: a job well done
li.description: We said we'd do it, and we did. The colony's word is good.
